_comment: Where every bundled asset file came from - see README.md. Each key is a path relative to the repository root. Every entry needs a description, a source (where it came from: a URL, or the session/commit that created it) and a license. The app's own work (LicenseRef-DiceFive-AllRightsReserved - see /LICENSE) also needs its copyright line. A third-party asset instead lists, in "libraries", the libraries/ entry for each source it was made from - those carry the license, copyright/credit and source URL, and are what the Licences dialog shows; "license" is the license of that source material. The build fails on any asset missing from here, any incomplete entry, and any entry whose file no longer exists.
